epoch50.engine.note: The TensorRT build's recorded drift, kept per this test's rule that a drifting build is kept and its drift RECORDED rather than silently accepted. All 17 per-clip hits match the checkpoint exactly; only the false-positive count differs, by one. Measured at NATIVE frame rate, which is how test_clip_regression.py runs. Sampling the same build at 10 FPS yields 3, matching the checkpoint — so this is a native-rate artefact of the engine build, not a recall regression. The paper's 3 false positives / 0.27 FP-per-minute remain the CHECKPOINT's numbers; quote the engine's separately if the engine is what shipped.
